reason: I already pay every month for a big fitness app that has a postpartum plan, and I barely use that one. Paying for a second program to do the same thing doesn't make sense. I might grab the free week at 2am, but I don't think I'd pay the $19.99.
objection: It's the same thing I've already got in my app. And with two little ones, 4 days a week still feels like a lot. What's going to make me actually stick with this one?
would_change_my_mind: If the free week showed me it was clearly better for my tummy gap and pelvic floor than my app, like a physio actually checking my progress or the check-ins really keeping me going, I'd cancel the app and switch to this.
